events.summary: Every candidate model is judged on three checks: 2023, 2024 and 2025 (176, 196 and 196 innings), each time learning only from the years before the one being checked. 2026 (171 innings) is kept for one final test. Split by year, never at random, and only IPL, BBL and full-member internationals are scored.
In the years before 2026, runs at the halfway mark times wickets in hand moves most closely with the final total (correlation 0.746). Sides with more wickets down add fewer runs in the second half.

Averaged over the three check years the TV projected score (current run rate x 20 overs) misses the real total by 21.6 runs. That is the score to beat. A know-nothing guess, the average total of the earlier test-population innings whatever the score at 10 overs, misses by 30.8 runs.
The language model proposes: runs_at_10 (all; none; population). It is not finished. Its reasoning is shown with this step.

events.summary: The rival tried every combination of training innings, window and weighting (24 considered, 24 fitted), running forward selection in each. Its best candidate model, learned from the last 3 seasons, with recent seasons counting much more, using full-member and league innings only, uses runs scored at the halfway mark, wickets in hand, innings played in the IPL, wickets lost in overs 7 to 10, sixes hit and runs in the current partnership and misses by 17.0 runs on average over the three checks. Choosing between the two methods on the checks: forward selection's best candidate model had the lower average validation error (17.03 against 17.82).

grid.caption: Two of the choices here, how many past seasons to learn from (the training window) and how much recent seasons count (the recency weighting), are hyperparameters: settings chosen before fitting, not learned from the data. This is the first app on the site to tune them, and the rival does it by trying every combination, which is called a grid search.

headlines.hero_h1: An AI agent built its own prediction model. Then it beat the TV.
headlines.lead: Halfway through a T20 innings, where will it finish? The agent chose the clues, code did the maths, and it was tested on a season it had never seen.
headlines.verdict_h2: On a season it never saw, the agent beat the TV by 3.5 runs.
headlines.vs_search: The agent matched the brute-force search, using just 5 tries.
